description: Irrigatiewater - Locatie beregeningsonttrekkingen uit grondwater en oppervlaktewater is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.rivm.nl. The ‘irrigation water’ card set consists of a combination of the following three card layers: • 5a: Impact of irrigation abstractions on groundwater well (indicator of impact of use of this ecosystem service, on the ecosystem services ‘water for terrestrial nature’ and ‘water for aquatic nature’). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Irrigation water - Location of irrigation abstractions from groundwater and surface water" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include watervoorziening, grondwater, beregening, landbouw. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
